sources.notes: Road surfaces are triangulated directly between this layout's saved road boundaries. Elevation follows the approximately 64 m terrain raster, not a survey of the road. Curbs are geometry-based illustrations on curved boundaries; their locations, widths, heights and colours are assumed, not extracted from imagery. Banking is unknown. The source is an open route or branch network, without one validated closed driving order. Choose an embedded component route for playback and recording; this network does not represent a single lap. Boundary coordinates and their separate feature-level licence are preserved. Imagery loads externally on demand; no image bytes or meshes are stored.

notes: Draft configuration: Original long circuit with smooth northeastern return and southern elongated connector; excludes the extra northeastern detour. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 2121.1 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.imageryCredit: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 64 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

notes: Draft configuration: Original short circuit with southwestern rounded hairpin and direct northeastern turn; excludes the northern infield loop. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
